summary.text: David Morales is a Democrat who has represented House District 7 in Providence (Mount Pleasant, Valley and Elmhurst) since first being elected in 2020, and who serves on the Labor, Innovation and Technology, and Municipal Government and Housing committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his biography, Morales was born September 16, 1998, and raised by a single immigrant mother in Soledad, California; he graduated from Soledad High School in 2016, earned a bachelor's degree in urban studies from the University of California, Irvine in 2018, and in 2019 became the youngest graduate in the history of Brown University's Public Affairs master's program.
He works as Director of Community Programs at the Woonasquatucket River Watershed Council.

The biography lists bills he sponsored on tip theft, immigration-status retaliation against whistleblowing employees, the winter utility shut-off moratorium, lead-poisoning prevention, the 2025 Freedom to Read Act, and a cap on specialty medication costs, and says he has introduced legislation for a single-payer health care system.
He is a member of the National Association of Latino Elected Officials, and the page describes him as the youngest Latino ever elected to a state legislature.
Outside government, he competes as a professional wrestler with the Renegade Wrestling Alliance.
